record.kind: Focused own-source repairs for two held CH import diagnostics

entries.finding: Primary entry asks about the contents of a box/container and states that a car has no contents. Its semantic object is what is contained, not commentary or descriptive information about the container. Applying it to the contents of a digital document is an explicit container-to-file extension. It is used here with an overt file possessor, not alone as a vague image-information noun.

quotes: Måolik mafa'tinas lånsa ginin i hayun nigas.
entries.finding: The chosen make verb denotes constructing an outcome. The N entry directly uses making an object from source material with ginin. The candidate applies that relation to producing a decoded picture in RAM from file contents. The secondary fotma entry also forms things from materials, but fotma is not needed in the proposed raw. Neither dictionary example alone is claimed to attest binary decoding; the explicit source/result/RAM relation supplies the functional meaning.

locators: ni line406 and ni håfa line410; Chung PDF398/400/401
entries.finding: The source relates a portion to its containing whole with gi, including a portion of a face and of a roof. Ni un påtti in the object position under ti is no portion whatsoever. This narrows the claim to delivered contents and avoids asserting either that the whole source file is absent or that merely some metadata failed to arrive. A portion of file contents is an authored digital part-whole relation, not a crop of the displayed picture.

Dokumentu is the already-established file convention; pinenta is picture. Dokumentun pinenta is an authored image-file compound with the regular post-head linker, and sinahguan i dokumentun pinenta identifies the actual contents of that file. It is not a file about a picture, a caption, author/licence record, or an external metadata description.

The receive verb, selected-tool passive and supplying-to-AN-Paint purpose clause are retained from the original research. Explicit recipient AN Paint before the supplied picture theme avoids dropping a ditransitive argument. This supplying tool remains distinct from ramienta para un atyik dokumentu, the picker description in the separately accepted rows.

pages_actually_read.support: Post-head possessor linker is -n after vowels and otherwise unrealized; sinahguan before its explicit file possessor needs no additional -n.
Post-head noun phrase modifiers carry the post-head linker on the head noun; dokumentu+pinenta gives dokumentun pinenta.
Primary examples show noun-noun content/type compounds using that linker; semantic file-picture combination remains authored.
Negative indefinites can use ni plus indefinite un and a noun.
Negative concord in nonsubject arguments; ti plus ni un portion/bit expresses not any, not two negatives cancelling.
Negative concord items may serve as direct objects, including this no-portion object.
Arguments other than subjects may have narrow scope under negation; the attempted un pinenta is an output object, not an assertion that it already exists.
Sinahguan is independently used for container contents with a possessive suffix; no digital attestation asserted.

TBX1294 pictorial image, not operating-system image6308.

record.kind: Own Chicontepec IDIEZ primary evidence for seven action/prerequisite candidates
record.identity: Tlahtolxitlauhcayotl. Chicontepec, Veracruz; John Sullivan and eight coauthors; IDIEZ and University of Warsaw, 2016, ISBN 978-83-63636-51-7. Publication page PDF5 actually viewed in this pass.

entries.sense_and_productive_use: Take/remove something out of a container or another thing. The selected assembly member is the implicit object; extending removal to a collection is authored. It does not mean erase all or merely unplace.
Exact dependent remove stem quixti, combined productively with xi- and c- for Xicquixti. No exact whole GUI command is claimed.
Specific third-person object prefix used after xi- and ti-.
Second-person imperative prefix. Commands are to the singular user.
Transitive selecting from a set; not reflexive animal-foraging sense2. Generic choosing also established by CATLINYA.
Dependent stem tlapehpeni before plural -can. Authored xi-c-tlapehpeni takes the separately attested transitive sense1, not the reflexive semantics of this stem example.
General selection among things/animals, not only sorting beans or corn.
One action first, then another. Names the missing selection prerequisite, not the ordinal first image.
Image made by instrument or hand. Bounded digital image extension; no other Nahuatl variety form imported.

The definition explicitly describes one or many words; another entry on the same page attests many images with unpluralized ixcopincayotl. Productive composition gives ce zo miac ixcopincayotl, one or multiple images, allowing nonempty selection. It does not impose a high numerical threshold for many.
Exact singular wait command, as someone is writing slowly. No physical-touch verb, short wait duration or automatic retry claim.
Temporal end boundary for an ongoing task; source example uses a present-form event after aztah. Combined with tlami without importing another variety's hasta/future wording.
An operation/task ends. This is intransitive end, not finish it, artwork completion or guaranteed successful output.
Work/task, extended to the bounded application operation holding the busy state.
Work/do work. Productive ti-tequiti means you work; used for the user's ability to work in the editor, not a claim that an operation finished.
This, referring to the current blocking operation.
Ability auxiliary which may lack its own subject prefix. Hueli titequiti is authored you can work, a functional readiness label rather than a completion/saved status.
Second-person singular subject prefix. Used with work and the future store verb.

Other entities/things apart from another set; uses the regular source spelling without macrons, paired with the own image noun. The noun remains unpluralized as the own source permits for many images.
Explicit selecting and identifying a location. The location clause in this UI points to storage, not a geographical destination or image coordinates.
Where a thing is or an event happens. Authored subordinate clause names where the user will save.

Entry explicitly describes storage of work made on a computer. Exact third-person and first-person future forms support productive second-person ti-c-ahcocui-z. The command initiates destination choice, not a claim that saving succeeded.

record.orthography: Unmacroned modern example spelling consistent with current NHE catalogue. Macrons retained only in source-headword labels. No NCH/NHW linguistic material or historical bracketed entries used.

look_command.finding: Primary entry labels this 2-look.I in reported instruction to look toward a direction. This supports the imperative token, including final glottal. Wilson printed84/PDF49 LOOK has the same long nasal accented stem in a direct command, but the scan lacks the final glottal used by this modern primary; modern whole-token spelling is selected rather than silently adding morphology to Wilson.

Parenthesized possessed noun under NAME. Initial í acute; final i unaccented; final glottal preserved.

decoding_caller_proof.head: 4fb1461a9186f057845c0acecfbfd1063afd8da4
decoding_caller_proof.raw: Android ti siña ha fa\'tinas un pinenta gi RAM ginin i sinahguan esti na dokumentu.
findings: This resource has exactly one production emitter, the Elvis null branch on BitmapFactory.decodeFile in ImportedImage.decode. It does not serve URI acquisition failure, missing dimensions, alternate native-codec decoders, colour conversion, rotation or later output resizing.

The function owns an actual java.io.File. withPlatformFile passes this file or a prepared BMP temporary file; withDecodeFile passes that input or a prepared colour-input temporary file. Every direct decoder call uses an actual file path. File contents are therefore a supported source referent, without claiming that every original byte reaches the platform decoder unchanged.

The missing result at this branch is a decoded Bitmap. Describing failure to make an image in RAM is a source/result paraphrase, not an out-of-memory diagnosis or promise that no temporary allocation occurred. It does not claim that the later colour conversion/orientation/resized output was already produced.
The exact wording remains independently accepted source/compositional paraphrase. Current code changes or reuse of this resource for another failure require recheck.
decoding_caller_proof.identity: All104 source SHA256/Git-blob identities were rehashed for the intake. 27 resource-only comparisons preserve them through this head. This is static source proof, not executed Android behavior.

static_source_identity.source_scope: Exact source hashes and resource-only comparisons, not runtime execution.
